metadata.title: SINT S.r.l. — Security engineering since 1990
metadata.description: Since 1990 SINT has designed security and building systems for companies and public bodies: risk assessment, tender specifications, design, works supervision and acceptance testing.

title: Since 1990
committed to technological innovation.
hero.copy: Design of video surveillance, access control and integrated security systems.

title: Knowledge is the
key to success.
paragraphs: SINT was founded in January 1990 to address safety issues, drawing on the expertise accumulated by its founder, Mario Vago, who had previously held managerial positions in leading companies within the sector.

Today, SINT is a leading company in the Italian market specialising in the study, design, construction and implementation of specialised comprehensive security solutions, electrical systems and air-conditioning systems, with the aim of reducing risk and keeping costs down.

items: Security systems: physical protection, intrusion detection, fire protection, CCTV and access control
Integration between the functions and controls of technical systems and security
Supervision and compliance: Local, regional and national supervisory systems; compliance with current regulations
Construction and Structures: Residential, commercial and industrial projects, and anti-seismic works
Building services: Electrical and specialised systems, mechanical and air-conditioning systems, fire protection and smoke extraction systems
Safety: Coordination during the design and construction phases

items.title: Risk management
items.text: Analysis of security strategies to identify all the main risks, seeking integrated solutions capable of meeting the various needs identified.

items.title: Building Automation
items.text: Feasibility study of automation measures, based on the users’ actual operational requirements, with a view to producing the detailed design for the installations.

items.title: Cabling and Networking
items.text: In partnership with Leviton (a certified global manufacturer), we design and implement cabling and networking solutions. A technical service specialising in integrated systems design.

items.title: Testing
items.text: SINT manages the full range of operations designed to verify the integrity and proper functioning of all components of the supplies, as commissioned by the Client, drawing up the required reports at each stage.

items.title: Supervision and Project Management
items.text: SINT assumes full responsibility for supervising and coordinating the construction work carried out by the contractors responsible for the works, effectively acting in the place of the Client in the management of contractual relations.

items.title: Tender Specifications/Comparison of Tenders
items.text: This is the stage  (which is extremely important for selecting the right suppliers) of drawing up, in a precise and unambiguous manner, the technical and functional specifications for the equipment to be supplied.

items.title: Plant Projects
items.text: Civil and industrial design of security, electrical and technological control systems, in accordance with established company standards and the most advanced and widely adopted regulations.

items.title: System Centralisation
items.text: In projects involving the centralisation of integrated security systems, SINT has gained such extensive and valuable experience that it is, in effect, the only consultancy firm currently active in this field in Italy.

caseStudies.description: Tender specifications, tender management, design, design review and works supervision for intrusion detection, access control and CCTV systems, with national centralised monitoring.
Risk assessment and design of security and CCTV systems for the postal sorting centres.
Risk assessment, security systems design, works supervision and acceptance testing at the Florence production site and the Milan showroom.
Technical and functional review and detailed design of fire protection, voice evacuation, CCTV, intrusion detection and access control systems.
Definitive design for upgrading the CCTV systems of Casa Museo Boschi, the Modern Art Gallery, Museo del Novecento and Palazzo Reale.
Delivery of the CCTV and perimeter protection systems.
